about_the_game:
In a land turned to ash, every bullet counts. The Last Zone blends fast-paced third-person combat with strategic base defense. Choose your weapons, lay traps, reinforce barricades, and plan against relentless waves of varied enemies. The wave system applies different pressure every run; you’ll answer with a new solution each time.

Manage resources and complete side objectives to strengthen your arsenal, trigger special abilities at the right moment, and dismantle threats from shambling zombies to towering bosses. With Endless Mode, jump back in again and again—each attempt demands a fresh plan.

Key Features

  • Fast firefights + smart defense: Marries third-person shooter action with trap/barricade placement.

  • Evolving enemy waves: Each wave hits harder; new types and behaviors force new tactics.

  • Extensive arsenal: Swap between powerful weapons, upgrade, and customize.

  • Trap & barricade system: Build, reinforce, and chain trap combinations.

  • Resources & side objectives: Scavenge the zone, complete tasks, and boost your offense and defense.

  • Boss encounters: Face tough enemies with distinct weak points and patterns.

  • Endless replayability: Dynamic waves and upgrades keep every run fresh.

Can you outlast the apocalypse and become the zone’s legendary defender?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows
  • Processor: Intel i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 2200G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050Ti / AMD Redeon RX 480
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 7 3800x
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2080 / AMD Redeon RX 5700Xt
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
